messages:
elaine: Hey team — thinking out loud about a microsite experiment: a guided pricing calculator that walks users through questions (use case, expected monthly tokens, latency sensitivity) and then recommends a tier + estimated monthly cost. Want to surface the tradeoffs (latency vs cost) and an option to sign up for a webinar if they want an enterprise walkthrough.

sam: love it. Is the ask that we A/B test the guided flow vs the current single-page calc?

elaine: yes — 50/50. Primary metrics: sign-up rate, playbook CTA clicks, time-to-quote. Secondary: bounce on calc and FAQ opens.

mike: will need dev hooks. Can we track each step as an event? e.g. `calc.step.1_use_case`, `calc.step.2_tokens`, `calc.result.recommendation`

jin: tagging infra: we should add a query param for marketing channel tagging so we can stitch back to GA: `?utm_source=calc_guided&utm_campaign=pricing_q2` — also capture cohort id for A/B.

elaine: perfect. Jin, can you own the instrumentation? Sam, can you own copy & flows? Mike, engineering feasibility & ETA? I can coordinate the webinar tie-in and creative.

sam: Yep. I’ll draft the script for each path (startup, mid-market, enterprise). Microcopy note: avoid "best for" language — instead use "optimized for" to keep tone technical.

mike: Feasibility: we can ship a client-side guided modal and backend for estimate calc in ~2 sprints if we scope MVP to 3 questions + result. Need design tokens and existing calculator logic.

jin: instrumentation ETA: I can have tracking events + UTM plumbing ready in 3 days, feature flags for AB in place. Also will add a `guided_cohort` field to events so analytics can segment.

elaine: timeline suggestion: design mock by EOD Wed, copy draft by Thu, dev sprint starts Mon, launch experiment the week after next. Are we aligned?

sam: aligned. I'll include the webinar CTA flow and an option to "book an enterprise consult" for heavy usage estimates.

mike: one question on pricing math — do we expose quantization/throughput assumptions on the result? e.g. "estimate assumes 8-bit quantized model, 16-tokens context avg"?

elaine: yes but keep it optional — have a "show assumptions" link beneath the estimate so folks who care can expand it. Non-technical users won't need it.

sam: for the FAQ update: add an entry "How do you estimate monthly costs?" that explains our assumptions and the tradeoffs between latency and unit cost. I'll draft in the doc.

marketing-bot: reminder: Q2 webinar slot reserved 2026-04-15 10:00PT for "Serving LLMs: Cost vs Latency" — confirm panelists.

elaine: confirmed — invite product + runtime + a customer if we can. Sam will prepare 5-min walkthrough of the calculator live.

mike: dev question — if a user toggles between "dedicated" and "hosted" in the calc, results will differ a lot. We'll need to show a clear delta and an explanation.

sam: right — show a comparative row: Hosted vs Dedicated (cost per 1M tokens, latency band). Keep numbers high-level.

elaine: ops checklist: 1) AB flag + cohort, 2) event instrumentation, 3) copy + microcopy, 4) design mocks, 5) rollout plan + kill-switch, 6) webinar CTA wiring, 7) update FAQ article + anchor link.

jin: I’ll create the event spec doc and link it here when done.

sam: I’ll put copy in the pricing doc: https://docs.internal/pricing-guided-calc (draft) — feedback welcome.

mike: can we reuse the existing calculator backend endpoint `/api/v1/estimate`? If yes, engineering lift is front-end + orchestration, much smaller.

elaine: reuse if possible. If we need a new endpoint for cohort-specific logic we can add it behind a feature flag.

sam: quick micro UX thought — add a progress bar: "Step 2 of 3" to reduce drop-off.

elaine: agreed. Also add an inline FAQ tooltip next to any jargon (quantization, tokens, throughput).

marketing-bot: A/B test template created: `pricing_guided_vs_control_2003456789` — auto instrumentation will collect signups, webinar clicks, and dropoff.

elaine: great. Next actions: Jin to post event spec by EOD tomorrow; Sam to post copy draft by Thu AM; Mike to confirm reuse of `/api/v1/estimate` and estimate engineering story points by Fri. I'll round up creative for the modal and the webinar CTA. Thanks team! :rocket:
